architecture.visual_identity: frozen 372-class HWR Top-5; exact identity can change only inside the selected semantic role when nested project selection enables it
architecture.context_attention: frozen Google BERT-Tiny masked attention over complete formula candidates and seven spatial relations
architecture.role_grammar: project-owned smoothed previous/current/next role model; no class-specific output head
architecture.exact_candidate_resolution: within-role frozen MASK evidence plus HWR probability; disabled unless selected on project-only validation
architecture.structural_guard: balanced directional fences plus nearest non-crossing absolute-value bars; relation-containing bar spans are rejected
architecture.trusted_top1_guard: preserve HWR Top-1 when at least 5 project observations are all correct
architecture.uncertainty_guard: add 0.25 decision margin when current HWR Top-1 has fewer than 5 project examples
architecture.candidate_contract: candidate-only finalization; no new token, deletion, or stroke-group mutation
